shared_drive_note: The storage root is shared with user photo/media trees and other unbacked data; the harness must not assume the full free-space pool is available for FlyBrain work.

warning_thresholds_gb.action: Trigger retention review and pause large downloads.
Stop creating new datasets and keep only active run artifacts.
Freeze nonessential writes and prune ephemeral caches.
Block all nonessential FlyBrain writes until storage falls below the soft cap.

lifecycle_pressure_response: At 75% of the hard cap (150 GB), run a retention review and archive old checkpoints, caches, and completed downloads that are no longer active.
At the soft cap (160 GB), stop creating new long-lived datasets, switch to read-only mode for noncritical analyses, and keep only the current active run plus the latest validated outputs.
At 90% of the hard cap (180 GB), freeze nonessential writes, purge tmp/staging/scratch directories, compress or remove duplicate artifacts, and require explicit override to continue.
At or above the hard cap (200 GB), block new writes immediately, drop ephemeral scratch, and only retain what is required to continue the current job safely.
